# ModelManager

Kind: context · Defined in [`src/renderer/model/model_manager.h`](../../../src/renderer/model/model_manager.h) · Described in `data/renderer.json`

Cache of glTF models and code-built meshes: path or key to the entity holding its ModelC.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `reg` | `entt::registry&` | the registry the model entities are made in (private) |
| `models` | `std::unordered_map<std::string, entt::entity>` | path or key to the entity holding its ModelC (private) |

## Notes

Emplaced by the Renderer's constructor, erased by Renderer::finish after the ModelC storage is cleared. Methods: load(path), get(path), add(key, MeshData). Main thread only.

## Side effects of those systems

- **[AnimalAgentView](../systems/AnimalAgentView.md)**
  - Loads the animal library index (preinit) and the viewed species (first tick) from disk on the main thread; logs which.
  - With "log", opens the file once (truncated) and appends a CSV line every frame, flushed.
  - ImGui window "Animal".
  - Creates host entities (one skin per world with a built bot, 800 tiles with marks) that are never destroyed (no finish).
- **[BoxRing](../systems/BoxRing.md)**
  - 12 dynamic boxes with Jolt bodies (made by RigidBodySys) 4 m + size above the ground, rotated about (1, 1, 0).
- **[BoxThrower](../systems/BoxThrower.md)**
  - A new entity with a dynamic Jolt body per click, never destroyed; colours cycle from a function-static counter.
- **[DebugMenu](../systems/DebugMenu.md)**
  - One ImGui window "Dynamical" (needs UI before it).
  - Changing the soil or grass height-map parameters makes SoilMaps / GrassPass bake their per-chunk maps again (they watch RenderSettings).
  - Creates torch entities and dynamic boxes (Jolt bodies through RigidBodySys) on button presses; destroys every PointLight entity on "No torches".
- **[GaitView](../systems/GaitView.md)**
  - ImGui window "Gait" (with "panel").
  - Pooled host marker entities, destroyed in finish.
- **[ModelLineup](../systems/ModelLineup.md)**
  - Lists ./resources/models with std::filesystem (errors ignored) and loads each .gltf / .glb: files read, GPU buffers uploaded by the model loader.
  - One dynamic Jolt body per model (RigidBodySys).
- **[PlayerModels](../systems/PlayerModels.md)**: none beyond its components.
- **[Renderer](../systems/service-Renderer.md)**
  - Creates the window, OpenXR session, Vulkan device and swapchain through Context.
  - Makes Lights, RayScene, ProbeVolume, PlantVolumes (with ray tracing), TreeShade, SoilMaps, ClassicRender, VRRender and the passes (SkyPass first, then the scene's renderer.passes).
  - GPU: per-frame fences and semaphores; one transfer, one compute and one graphics submission a frame; waits on the frame fence in prepare and on device idle in init and finish.
  - Threads: records both targets concurrently on the taskflow executor.
  - Log: 'Renderer : unknown pass <name>' (error).
  - Profiler zones: create lighting and targets, create pass / pipelines <name>, update <pass>, Update, Record, Submit.
- **[SphereView](../systems/SphereView.md)**
  - ImGui window "Sphere roller"; collapses "Dynamical", "Worlds" and "Frame time" on first use.
  - Five host entities for the markers, destroyed in finish.
- **[VRControl](../systems/VRControl.md)**
  - Hands are only made when VRInput is enabled and box.gltf loads; the RigidBody system gives them kinematic Jolt bodies that push dynamic bodies around.
  - Each press of the right trigger spawns a box 20 cm ahead of the controller with 1.5x the hand's velocity (a new entity and Jolt body per press, never destroyed).
- **[WorldView](../systems/WorldView.md)**
  - Uploads generated capsule meshes to the GPU through ModelManager::add (Transfer), once per size.
  - Creates and destroys host entities as bodies appear and go; destroys all of them in finish.
